**Page:**  
Title: *Doctors say 5 patients died during power failure at Tijuana hospital*  
URL: https://mexiconewsdaily.com/news/doctors-say-5-patients-died-during-power-failure-at-tijuana-hospital/

**Evidence**  
- **Event:** Power outage at Tijuana General Hospital.  
  *“Loss of power occurred for a few hours on Saturday, and then again on Sunday for most of the day, and is attributed to the theft of wiring from an electrical substation.”*  
- **Fatalities:** Five intubated coronavirus patients died.  
  *“Five intubated coronavirus patients died over the weekend at Tijuana’s General Hospital…”*  
- **Generator status:** Generator not in proper working order; did not supply power to elevators.  
  *“The hospital’s generator was not in proper working order”* and *“the generator did not supply power to the elevators…”*  
- **Ventilator battery:** Internal battery lasts four to six hours.  
  *“…the ventilators have an internal battery that lasts from four to six hours…”*  
- **Date of article:** October 28, 2020.  
- **Slated dates of outage:** Saturday and Sunday of the weekend.  
  *“…the loss of power occurred for a few hours on Saturday, and then again on Sunday…”*  

**Coverage**  
Entities: Tijuana General Hospital, 5 patients (intubated coronavirus patients).  
Conditions: Fatal power outage, generator malfunction, theft of wiring.  
Dates: Saturday/Sunday (weekend, 2020), article date 2020‑10‑28.  
Measurements: Power outage duration (few hours Saturday, most of Sunday); ventilator battery 4–6 hours.  
The list above is exhaustive for what is explicitly stated on the supplied page.

- Confirmation that the deaths were directly caused by the outage (only implied).
